meta.purpose: Regression baseline for SameChannelPolicy merge decisions. Prevents threshold tuning from fixing one over-merge while silently breaking known-good merges.
meta.pairwise_note: Pairwise tests use a seed-only event from candidate_a, then score candidate_b. No state accumulation — conservative for SHOULD_MERGE, appropriate for SHOULD_NOT_MERGE. Stateful failures (where accumulated conversation_ids cause the problem) will only appear in end-to-end tests.
meta.acceptance: SHOULD_MERGE passed, SHOULD_NOT_MERGE passed, good small events preserved, over-merged chains reduced. Fragmentation (everything → isolated) is not acceptable.

pairwise.notes: Same story, same science channel. Two consecutive 35-min windows of the same diabetes/journals story. Should merge on top_conv_match + strong kw/domain overlap.
Microsoft open-source tools hacked / password theft. Two tech-channel candidates 35 min apart. High kw (github/security/access) and domain (techcrunch/github/macrumors) overlap.

Apple WWDC livestream candidate → Apple Gemini AI architecture announcement. Same WWDC event progression, strong apple/siri/google/gemini keyword coherence expected. Tests whether event merges across different story IDs within the same tech news event.
Switzerland population referendum. Two general-channel candidates with consistent switzerland/population/swiss/admin.ch keywords and domains. Both from the clean 2-candidate event.

SBF pardon (pardons/pardon/trump) vs Brexit referendum flip. Different stories. Shared Bloomberg/TechCrunch domains and startup channel, but keyword_overlap should be near zero. This is a known failing case with current policy (startup channel has no kw_overlap==0 block).

DaVinci Resolve / Gemma 4 12B window (features/quantum/models/google keywords) vs Elixir v1.20 gradual typing release. Different technical topics. Candidate_a id is inferred from audit (verify if SKIP).

Elixir v1.20 gradual typing release vs abortion/miscarriage story (faced/threatening/miscarriage/abortion keywords). Completely different topics. General channel kw_overlap==0 block should reject this. Tests that our general channel fix holds. (candidate_a is cluster 0 — the true Elixir discussion; cluster 2 is a noise cluster with spam keywords)

xAI datacenter REIT story (where/social/into/back/data) vs Switzerland population referendum (population/switzerland/swiss). Generic keyword overlap on where/social/into is not event identity. In pairwise seed test this may correctly not merge; the accumulated state bug surfaces in e2e.

Switzerland population cap referendum vs farmer donated land / city building data center. Different civic stories. From same window (same parquet file, different cluster). Domain or conversation overlap should not be enough.

Apple WWDC Livestream (apple/siri/live/zig/macos) vs Nvidia partners with LG robotics to build humanoid robots. Same tech window and shared domains (apple.com/github.com), but completely different event. Tests that domain overlap alone does not carry a tech-channel merge.

Cloudflare Turnstile WebGL fingerprinting vs a non-Cloudflare general candidate from the adjacent window. Tests that a strong Cloudflare event does not absorb unrelated general candidates due to window proximity. Candidate_b id is approximate (cluster 1 in next window); verify if SKIP.

expected_same_event.notes: Both diabetes candidates must land in the same TrackedEvent. A single coherent 2-candidate science event.
Both Microsoft-hacked candidates must land in the same TrackedEvent.
The clean 2-candidate Switzerland referendum event must remain merged.

expected_different_events.notes: SBF pardon and Brexit referendum must be in different events. Currently failing — startup channel has no kw_overlap==0 block.
xAI datacenter REIT and Switzerland referendum must not share an event. Currently failing due to conv_overlap accumulation (stateful bug).
Switzerland referendum and farmer/park land story must be separate events. Same window, different clusters.
Apple Gemini AI announcement and Nvidia/LG robotics candidate must be separate events.
Elixir v1.20 and abortion/miscarriage story must be separate. kw_overlap==0 general block should prevent this merge. (cluster 0 is the true Elixir discussion; cluster 2 was a noise cluster)
